title: PureLottery: Fair Leader Election Without Decentralized Random Number Generation
abstract: PureLottery studies leader election through a tournament structure, using strategic interaction to obtain fair selection without a standalone distributed randomness service. The paper analyzes the protocol and its incentives in the stated model. It belongs to the broader line of work on randomness and decentralized coordination.
summary: Uses a tournament among participants to elect a fair leader without first running a separate distributed random-number generation service.
